  "observation": "While I held the cup near the person's right hand, they pointed to the tabletop in front of them. I moved the cup toward that spot.",
  "interpretation": "The gesture suggested they wanted me to set the drink down where they pointed.",
  "title": "Drink placement",
  "note": "On this occasion, the person indicated a spot on the table when I offered their drink.",
  "question": "For future drinks, would you like me to set the cup on the table in front of you?"
}
